requirements.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:20 `public function submit(): void` then line 41 `return redirect()->route('home');` (compile-time fatal: void function must not return a value); same in app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:26/50. app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordResetController.php:5-264 redeclares the same aliases (e.g. `ValidatorFacade`, `AuthFacade`, `Password`, `Hash`) dozens of times -> fatal 'name already in use'. `Request` is imported as the Facade (line 22) so `Request $request` type-hints are wrong; `Password::defaults()` at line 285 calls the broker facade, not Rules\Password. Controllers in App\Http\Controllers\Auth extend an unimported `Controller`. No .env.example or phpunit.xml changes; no redirect()->intended(); existing views not fixed.

conventions.evidence: No #[Validate] attributes in Login/Register (inline `$this->validate([...])`); views load Bulma from a CDN (resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:6) and duplicate full HTML documents instead of using the layout/Blade components; no docs/CHANGELOG updates; layouts/app.blade.php:19 uses an inline onclick handler; no tests written test-first.

security.evidence: VerificationController.php:41-47 ignores `$id`/`$hash` and verifies whatever user is logged in, so a valid signed link for another account verifies the current user's unowned e-mail; Login.php:28 `exists:users,email` enumerates accounts and bypasses the failed-attempt counter; PasswordResetController.php:270 returns `trans($response)` which differs for unknown users (passwords.user), revealing existence; verification.notice route (routes/web.php:37) has no auth middleware so Auth::user() can be null. Positives: session regenerate, remember_token rotation, throttle on password.email, Blade `{{ }}` escaping.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all (no tests/Feature/*), despite conventions requiring tests for every feature plus unauthorized/tamper tests for Livewire actions.

simplicity.evidence: PasswordResetController.php:5-282 has ~270 lines of repeated, unused `use` statements; VerificationController.php:5-32 imports ~28 unused facades; VerificationController.php:43-45 empty `if` with `// do nothing`; four views each repeat a full <html> skeleton instead of using layouts.auth.

readability.evidence: Wall of duplicated imports (PasswordResetController.php:5-282), dead code `if (...) { // do nothing }` (VerificationController.php:43-45), rambling comments in AppServiceProvider.php:24-29 ('Note: Password facade already imported...'), `use` statements placed mid-file in routes/web.php:14-18, missing trailing newlines.

scope.evidence: Changes stay on the auth feature (controllers, Livewire components, views, lang, routes, User model); the only extras are unrequested `verify_email.*` keys added to lang/*/auth.php instead of ui.php.

issues.explanation: The same import aliases are declared many times, which is a PHP fatal error, so the password reset controller cannot even load.
`submit(): void` returns a redirect, a compile-time fatal error that breaks the login component (same in Register.php:26,50).
`Request` is the Facade, not Illuminate\Http\Request, and `Password::defaults()` is called on the broker facade rather than Rules\Password, so reset validation cannot work.
Controllers in the Auth namespace extend `Controller` without importing App\Http\Controllers\Controller, so the class is not found.
No tests at all are shipped for login, register, logout, reset, verification or localization.
verify() ignores the id and hash and marks the current user verified, so any valid signed link verifies an account whose e-mail it does not own.
`exists:users,email` reveals whether an account exists and fails before the rate limiter is hit, instead of returning auth.failed.
Flashes `trans($response)`, which is passwords.user for unknown e-mails, revealing whether the e-mail exists, against requirement 5.
The required APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE settings and phpunit locale pins are missing.
Uses undefined keys like `auth.email`, `auth.passwords.email` and `verification.sent`, so raw keys show on screen and the en/pt_BR text checks fail.
Existing views and routes were not updated to remove hardcoded paths as requirement 9 asks, and login does not use redirect()->intended().
verification.notice has no auth middleware, so a guest hitting it or the resend flow gets a null user.
Livewire full-page component views use @extends instead of a layout with a single root element, which Livewire 4 does not support for components.
Validation uses inline rule arrays instead of the project's `#[Validate]` attribute pattern.
Loads Bulma 0.9.4 from a CDN and repeats full HTML documents instead of using the app's assets and layout.
No docs or CHANGELOG updated for the new auth feature.
Dozens of unused imports and an empty `// do nothing` branch are dead code.
Redundant, rambling comments about the import and the Laravel version.

review.summary: The change adds Livewire login/register components, password reset, verification and logout controllers, routes, views and ui translations, but several files cannot run: void methods return redirects, PasswordResetController has hundreds of duplicate imports and the Request facade is used as a type hint. There are also security gaps (account enumeration, a verification link that ignores id/hash), required config and localization pieces are missing, and there are no tests at all, so this must be rejected.
